settings.text: Got questions? We've got answers. Find everything you need to know about shopping with Lumu below.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content: Standard delivery takes 3-5 business days across the United States. Major metropolitan areas typically receive orders within 2-3 business days.

settings.heading: Is shipping really free?
settings.row_content: Yes! We offer free standard shipping on all orders over $50. Orders below $50 have a flat shipping fee of $4.99.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.row_content: Once your order ships, you'll receive a tracking number via email. You can also track your order from your account page on our website.

settings.heading: Do you deliver to all states in the US?
settings.row_content: Yes! We deliver nationwide across all 50 states in the United States, including Alaska and Hawaii, through our trusted partners like UPS, FedEx, and USPS.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return policy. If you're not satisfied with your purchase, simply initiate a return within 30 days of delivery and we'll process your refund.

settings.heading: How do I return an item?
settings.row_content: Contact our support team via email or our contact page with your order number. We'll provide a pre-paid shipping label for you to easily send your items back.

settings.heading: When will I receive my refund?
settings.row_content: Refunds are processed within 5-7 business days after we receive and inspect the returned item. The amount will be credited back to your original payment method.

settings.heading: What payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover), Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal. All online payments are fully secured with SSL encryption.

settings.heading: Are payment plans available?
settings.row_content: Yes! We offer flexible buy now, pay later options through Shop Pay Installments and PayPal Pay in 4 at checkout, allowing you to split your purchase into interest-free payments.

settings.heading: Are my payment details safe?
settings.row_content: Absolutely. Our website is protected with industry-standard SSL encryption. We never store your card details on our servers. All transactions are processed through secure, PCI-compliant payment gateways.

settings.text: Our support team is available to help. Reach out to us anytime via our contact page or email support@lumu.com.
